cur:monumental2-saqqara-virgin-enthroned.summary: The Virgin sits frontally on a jewelled throne with the Christ Child on her lap, both looking straight out; two youthful archangels raise their hands in acclamation on either side, and two elderly saints stand at the ends, one holding a book. Fragmentary Greek or Coptic labels survive above the heads. The flat, brightly coloured figures are known here through the colour plate of the 1912 excavation report.
facts: The picture is a colour plate from Quibell's 1912 report on the Monastery of Apa Jeremias, whose monks' cells were decorated with prayer-niche paintings of Christ, the Virgin and the monastery's founders.

links.label: Internet Archive: Quibell, Excavations at Saqqara (1912)

cur:monumental2-saqqara-virgin-enthroned.notes: The image is a 1912 colour reproduction rather than a photograph. The inscription at the left appears to begin with the name of Apa Jeremias, but the saints' identities were not confirmed.
